Seismic waves
An earthquake generates **P, S and L (surface) waves** – "P.S.L". P and S are **body waves**.
**P-waves are sound (acoustic) waves:** compressional like sound, and they become audible sound when they reach the air.
Wave speed changes with density → **reflection and refraction** at boundaries reveal the layers. The **S-wave** behaviour (vanishing in the outer core) is the evidence of a **liquid outer core**.
